title: Steam Game Studio Lead Scraper Input
description: Search Steam and extract game studio leads. Pay per lead.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Genres or themes to search for (e.g. roguelike, city builder, horror, visual novel).

country.title: Country
country.description: Two-letter store country code. Default us.

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Cap total leads scored per run. Steam detail lookups are rate-limited, so very large runs take longer.

minReviews.title: Minimum reviews
minReviews.description: Drop games with fewer reviews than this. Zero keeps everything.

qualifiedMinReviews.title: Qualified review bar
qualifiedMinReviews.description: Reviews at or above this, with a scraped email, tier a lead as qualified_lead.

includeEmail.title: Scrape contact emails
includeEmail.description: Fetch each studio website and scrape a contact email.

maxEmailLookups.title: Max email lookups
maxEmailLookups.description: Cap how many top leads get the website email scrape.

concurrency.title: Concurrency (website scrape)
concurrency.description: Studio websites fetched in parallel. Steam detail lookups are always throttled separately.
